Renee (AE): ProspectPulse wants a short 4-week trial. Musts: VPC peering + KMS, retention=30d. Acceptance asks: p95 <= 175ms in-region, quality >= 93% on 125 labeled prompts, cost target <= $0.31/1k tokens. Can engineering sketch a minimal runnable acceptance playbook + burn estimate? Kickoff Thu 11am PT.

Omar (Sales-Eng): I'll own the eval harness. Need prompt mix and reference labels. Also want their expected concurrency profile (QPS).

Becky (Solutions): Recommended starting config: redwood-rt-13b-quant, kv_cache=true, batch_size=6, prefix_cache for system prompts. We'll include a trimmed 7B variant if latency needs more headroom.

Sam (SRE): Quick token math: assume avg 260 tokens/req and target 14 RPS peak -> 260*14=3640 tokens/s ~13.1M tokens/hr. For an acceptance-focused 40 peak-hours plan ~524M tokens is high; propose baseline burn=180M tokens. At $0.31/1k tokens that's ~$55.8k gross. Suggest offering $20k pilot credit and cap exposure at $30k.

Ivy (Product): Acceptance gates: 1) Automated eval (125 prompts) >=93% 2) p95 <=175ms under their 90th-percentile load 3) No critical PII leakage on a 20-case adversarial set 4) Billable usage <= agreed cap 5) Final sign-off after 10 manual spot-checks.

Becky (Solutions): Eval snippet I'll use to capture latency/output and save to CSV. We'll enable response_dedupe during automated runs to limit repeated burn.

Sam (SRE): Security checklist: need CIDR for peering, KMS key ARN, and preferred region. For Dedicated VPC provisioning ETA is 4 business days after we have artifacts. infra-bot: ticket created RB-2140.

Renee (AE): Thanks team. Action items: Omar = harness + scoring by Wed EOD; Sam = infra ticket follow-up; Becky = canary config + model variants. Please update thread when items complete :thumbsup:
